title: Pawn Stars

title: Pawn Stars

S21 E08 — The Glowing Orb Phenomenon
Across the globe, reports of mysterious glowing orbs are on the rise; their movements frequently defy the laws of physics, and now they are even being reported near military bases, ships, and nuclear weapon facilities.

title: Ancient Aliens
description:
S21 E09 — The Legacy of J. Allen Hynek
Dr. J. Allen Hynek was a pioneering scientist who developed smart weapons, optical tracking systems and space satellites; yet he is best known as the notorious government UFO debunker who became one of the founding fathers of ufology.

title: Ancient Aliens
description:
S21 E10 — The Volcano Factor
Volcanoes have inspired countless myths and legends, but curiously, they are also major hotspots for UFO sightings; is it possible that these geological formations, which can generate great energy, are attracting otherworldly visitors?

title: Ancient Aliens
description:
S21 E12 — The Abduction Files
All over the world, there are people who claim they have been abducted by aliens; since the 1970s, a growing number of researchers have dedicated their lives to uncover what is behind this disturbing phenomenon.

title: Ancient Aliens
description:
S21 E13 — The Giants
Examining how thousands of years ago, people all over the world described encounters with enormous, human-like beings; exploring how some archaeologists claim to have found skeletons of extraordinary size; is it possible the giants actually existed?

title: Ancient Aliens
description:
S21 E14 — Aliens in Our Midst
In the age of smartphones and social media, more evidence of otherworldly activity has come to light than ever before.

title: Ancient Aliens
description:
S22 E01 — Skulls of the Gods
In every corner of the world, archaeologists have found strange, elongated skulls; did our ancestors modify the shape of their skulls to resemble extraterrestrial visitors?

title: Ancient Aliens
description:
S22 E02 — Egypt's Lost Pyramids
High above the Giza Plateau stands Egypt's most mysterious ancient site: the Lost Pyramid of Abu Rawash.

title: Ancient Aliens
description:
S22 E03 — Island of the Gods
Oceania contains remote Pacific islands featuring massive stone structures and strange statuary; local legends describe otherworldly visitors, adding to the mystery of these ancient sites.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S01 E10 — Decoding Genius
Discussing whether genius is born or made; whether clues can be found by examining the brains of extraordinary thinkers like Albert Einstein.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S01 E11 — Secrets of Ancient Civilizations
Uncovering the secrets behind ancient cultures and civilizations such as the Mayan empire, the Khmer people at Angkor Wat and the Roman city of Pompeii.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S01 E24 — Encountering Evil
While many believe that there is some darkness in our world, people wonder if it's something that emanates from strange locations, something that tempts humanity, or a feeling that invades.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S02 E02 — Legendary Weapons
Do certain weapons recorded in the pages of history, like the dagger of King Tut or the Swords of Damascus, actually contain incredible power?

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S01 E15 — Monster Mayhem
Analyzing if monsters exist, creatures who lurk in dense forests or fly over large cities; for centuries, monsters like Mothman, the Thunderbird, and Bigfoot have mystified witnesses, skeptics, and scientists alike.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S02 E03 — Powerful Predictions
Throughout history, many prophecies and figures like Liu Bowen and the Oracle of Delphi, who claim to see the future, influence powerful nations; predicting the future remains either an inherited trait or a learned skill.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S01 E05 — Dark Forces
Exploring if dark, powerful energies permeate the human world, or if it is all just myth and superstition.

title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
description:
S01 E25 — Beyond Death
Throughout human history, how the dead are treated is as important as how the living are treated, and questions of both death and the afterlife have been at the heart of every known culture.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E07 — Dodging Death
A brush with death is terrifying enough-but these stories take survival to the extreme; like fending off a black bear while dangling off a cliff; drifting through shark-infested waters with nothing but a pair of rubber boots to stay afloat.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E03 — Astonishing Bodies
From a headless chicken that lives over one year, to an out-of-this-world "celestial body" where it rains molten glass, the team explores the most astonishing bodies through these truly unbelievable stories.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E05 — Man vs. Nature
Mother Nature doesn't always play nice, whether it's a mile-long sinkhole, a biblical swarm of crop-killing grasshoppers or an invasion of rum-fueled monkeys running wild on the island of St. Kitts; stories where humans go head-to-head with nature.
